if: the document is a tax invoice required by section 31 and issued under rule 46 of the CGST Rules, 2017
no provision of rule 54 (tax invoice in special cases) displaces the particular
then: the tax invoice MUST carry the amount of tax charged, identified by head: central tax, State tax, integrated tax, Union territory tax or cess
note: One mandatory particular of rule 46(m), addressable on its own so that a missing field names the clause it breaches.

evidence.quote: amount of tax charged in respect of taxable goods or services (central tax, State tax, integrated tax, Union territory tax or cess);
